method: Playwright responsive workspace suite across its configured Chromium projects.

checks.name: Persistent lineage remains visible and within the viewport
Project menu and lineage controls do not overlap
checks.coverage: Run/save workflow asserts adjacent hit targets at all four viewports, including 1024px.

checks.name: Planning context remains text-visible as header content compresses
checks.coverage: The primary planning label is retained and ellipsized at narrower widths; Scenario/Version/draft details remain in the lineage disclosure.

checks.name: Workspace stages and Results/Data/Report destinations remain reachable
RF controls remain usable with failed basemap tiles
checks.coverage: Responsive browser suite at all four viewport projects.

skipReason: The configured suite skips real-backend-only scenarios without ATOM_REAL_E2E and skips the mobile-only rail assertion on non-mobile projects.
limitations: Chromium viewport smoke; not a screenshot pixel-diff audit or a full assistive-technology review.
